description: A drum voice made of two oscillators, blended from their plain sum towards a ring modulation of the pair

params.text: Sets how long the voice rings after a trigger, from 5ms up to about a third of a second
Sets the frequency of the first oscillator
Switches both oscillators from sine waves to square waves
Blends the output from the sum of the two oscillators towards their ring modulation
Sets the frequency of the second oscillator

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V restarts the decay
Adds to the decay setting, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the first oscillator's frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the ring modulation blend, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
A gate above 0.5V switches both oscillators to square waves whatever the switch is set to
Adds to the second oscillator's frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
